t: $(thing)Conditions/$ are a collection of widgets that allow you to check something, and jump to another part of your program if the check succeeds.$(p)Every $(thing)Condition/$ widget takes a $(l:programming/text)Text/$ widget parameter (which is always the bottom-most parameter) configured with a $(thing)label name/$.
$(thing)条件/$是一组控件，可让你检查某些内容，并在检查成功时跳转到程序的另一部分。$(p)每个$(thing)条件/$控件都需要一个$(l:programming/text)文本/$控件参数（始终是最底部的参数），并将其配置为$(thing)标签名称/$。

When a condition evaluates $(thing)true/$, $(l:programming/flow_control)program execution/$ will jump to a $(l:programming/label)Label/$ widget with the same name as that $(thing)Text/$ parameter on its $(italic)right-hand/$ side. When the condition is $(thing)false/$, it will jump to a $(thing)Label/$ with the same name as the $(thing)Text/$ parameter on its $(italic)left-hand side/$.$(p)When the $(thing)Condition/$ widget can't find a valid $(thing)Text/$ parameter, it will just proceed to the next widget (connected $(italic)below/$).

当一个条件计算结果为$(thing)true/$时，$(l:programming/flow_control)程序执行/$将跳转到一个$(l:programming/label)标签/$组件，该组件的名称与其$(italic)右侧/$的那个$(thing)文本/$参数相同。若条件为$(thing)false/$，则会跳转到一个$(thing)标签/$组件，其名称与$(italic)左侧/$的$(thing)文本/$参数相同。$(p)当$(thing)条件/$组件找不到有效的$(thing)文本/$参数时，它将直接继续执行下一个组件（连接在$(italic)下方/$的那个）。
$(italic)A Redstone Condition widget which kills the drone if the signal >= 10/$
$(italic)一个红石条件控件，当信号 >= 10 时会销毁无人机/$

Most $(thing)Condition/$ widgets can be $(thing)right-clicked/$ to open a configuration GUI. The GUI will usually contain '='/'>=' options, and a textfield where you can enter a number.$(p)With this you can set up conditions (like item counts in a chest) to be e.g. exactly 10 ('=' mode and textfield 10), more than 20 ('>=' mode and textfield '21'), or less than 12 ('>=' mode and textfield '12', but checking for the condition to be $(thing)false/$).

大多数$(thing)条件/$组件都可以通过$(thing)右击/$来打开配置 GUI。该 GUI 通常会包含“=”/“>=”选项，以及一个可供输入数字的文本框。$(p)借此，你可以设置各种条件（例如箱子中的物品数量），比如恰好为 10（“=”模式，文本框填 10）、大于 20（“>=”模式，文本框填“21”），或小于 12（“>=”模式，文本框填“12”，但要检查该条件是否为$(thing)false/$）。

All $(thing)Condition/$ widget GUI's (except $(l:programming/condition_item)Condition: Item Filter/$) have a $(thing)Measure/$ textfield, where you can enter the name of a $(l:programming/variables)variable/$. If a variable name is supplied here, any measurement made by the drone will be stored in the X field of the variable.$(p)This can then be later used like any other variable, e.g. you could measure the level of a fluid tank, and write it on a sign.

所有$(thing)条件/$组件的 GUI（$(l:programming/condition_item)条件：物品过滤器/$除外）都有一个$(thing)测量/$文本框，你可以在其中输入一个$(l:programming/variables)变量/$名称。如果这里填写了变量名，那么无人机进行的任何测量结果都会存入该变量的 X 字段。$(p)之后它就可以像其他变量一样使用，例如你可以测量一个流体储罐的液位，并把结果写在告示牌上。

If a measuring variable name is supplied, then it's no longer an error to have no branching Text widgets on the Condition widget (normally at least one branch is required). This means that the Condition widget can be used purely to measure a quantity; execution will just proceed downwards as normal.$(p)Note: pressure measurement conditions store the measured pressure in millibars (e.g. 5.5 bars would be 5500).
如果提供了测量变量名，那么条件组件上没有分支文本组件时就不再算作错误（通常至少需要一个分支）。这意味着条件组件可以纯粹用于测量某个数值；执行将像平常一样继续向下进行。$(p)注意：压力测量条件会将测得的压力以毫巴为单位存储（例如 5.5 bar 会存为 5500）。

Conditions can be divided into two categories: $(thing)World Conditions/$ and $(thing)Drone Conditions/$.$(p)World Conditions are used to check for things in the world, e.g. does a $(item)Chest/$ have a certain number of items, or does a block exist somewhere?$(p)$(thing)Drone Conditions/$ specifically target the $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$, e.g. does the Drone have a certain item, or have a certain pressure?
条件可以分为两类：$(thing)世界条件/$和$(thing)无人机条件/$。$(p)世界条件用于检查世界中的事物，例如$(item)箱子/$里是否有一定数量的物品，或某处是否存在某个方块。$(p)$(thing)无人机条件/$则专门针对$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$本身，例如无人机是否携带某个物品，或是否具有某个压力值。

All block-based $(thing)World Conditions/$ have an $(thing)Any/All/$ block option. This is used when you're checking multiple blocks at a time.$(li)In $(thing)Any/$ mode, only $(italic)one/$ of the blocks in the selected $(l:programming/area)area/$ needs to match for the condition to be $(thing)true/$.$(li)In $(thing)All/$ mode, $(italic)all/$ blocks must match for the condition to be $(thing)true/$.

所有基于方块的$(thing)世界条件/$都有一个$(thing)任意/全部/$方块选项。当你一次检查多个方块时，就会用到它。$(li)在$(thing)任意/$模式下，所选$(l:programming/area)区域/$内的方块只需要有$(italic)一个/$匹配，条件就会为$(thing)真/$。$(li)在$(thing)全部/$模式下，必须$(italic)全部/$方块都匹配，条件才会为$(thing)真/$。
